notes.title: The Forge of Iron and Steel Burns Hot - Conquest The Realm of Tyraellia
notes.content:
[i]The heralds sing of momentous tidings from the lands of Crestfallen: a bountiful transformation has swept across our world, promising fairer fortunes and newfound perils alike. Gather thy wits and steady thy blade as we recount these updates, crafted by the hands of our guilded artisans and sorcerers. Heed well, for the realm flourishes anew.[/i]
[h2]The Harvest Re-Scattered: Nodes of Plenty and Purpose[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/95ce7881fd252fae29a8b726ac1dfb1939427f56.jpg[/img]
In the name of balance and prosperity, the resources of Crestfallen have been re-scattered across the land. No longer shall ye wander aimlessly in search of precious ores, rare herbs, or timber. Nodes now lie plentiful and more thoughtfully placed, with their locations attuned to the needs of craftsmen and gatherers. Seek thy bounty in regions where it doth most belong: iron near the craggy heights, herbs within meadows kissed by morning dew, and lumber by rivers where life teems.

This restructuring ensures that all adventurers, be they seasoned veterans or fledgling explorers, shall find the fruits of the land more readily at hand. Go forth and reap what the gods have scattered!

[h2]Banishing the Haunt of Floating Oddities and Treacherous Trenches[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/ef1bda995cb1dc734f7d2a6ed11c526e86c46b1f.jpg[/img]
The artisans of Crestfallen have worked tirelessly to mend the world’s imperfections. Gone are the mysterious floating objects that once marred the skies, strange specters of what should lie grounded. Similarly, the cruel terrain traps that ensnared many an unwary traveler have been filled, smoothed, and sealed by the earth’s embrace. Let none fear stumbling into these deceptive chasms again!

Rejoice, for the land now stands firm and fair beneath thy feet. Thy travels shall henceforth be unmarred by such wayward pitfalls.

[h2]Treasures Beckon: Riches Enhanced in the Demonic Ruins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/627303ca8b7530b390848a8ae7d544d43146fca8.jpg[/img]
The dark corridors of the Demonic Ruins, steeped in shadow and menace, now promise greater rewards for the brave who dare tread their depths. Whispers tell of relics and spoils awaiting the bold, their worth now heightened to reflect the dangers lurking within.

But tread carefully, for where treasures grow more plentiful, so too does the vigilance of the dark guardians who covet them. Sharpen thy steel, muster thy courage, and claim what is rightfully thine.

[h2]Fortune Within the Orcen Encampment of RockThralm[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/c1e21e3f3c1b16f71261f9ab0876aac15ab2e836.jpg[/img]
The Orcen encampment at RockThralm has become an even greater lure for adventurers seeking fame and wealth. Their strongboxes brim with treasures untold, their loot enhanced to entice the most daring of raiders. The clang of their hammers and guttural war cries echo through the hills, forewarning of their fierce resolve.

Should thou venture into the encampment, remember: riches await only those with the strength to conquer and the wisdom to retreat when danger swells. Assemble thy companions and let the plunder of RockThralm add glory to thy name.

[h2]Thinning the Forests: A Path Clearer Through the Wilds[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/dcbf55a0acd2268b7f398ebf152ce83b36c411b9.jpg[/img]
The dense, labyrinthine forests of Crestfallen, though fair and full of mystery, have been tempered by the axe of reason. Many trees have been felled, allowing clearer passage and kinder navigation through these verdant realms. No longer shall adventurers find themselves lost for hours amid endless groves.

These changes, though subtle, open the lands to greater exploration. Yet take heed, for even thinned forests may still conceal danger. The wilds remain ever untamed, and shadows linger amidst the glades.

[h2]Cleansing the Blight of Wayward Nodes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/1366be0d5a66ebf3cdbb99ed3e74ba0cd9c8e44d.jpg[/img]
A vexing curse hath been lifted! Resource nodes, once plagued by strange respawn behaviors, have been cleansed of their mischief. Miners and gatherers alike shall now find the land’s bounty behaving as intended, reappearing with the natural rhythm of the realm.

No more shall thou wait in frustration or find thy resources gone awry. This restoration of harmony ensures that the industrious may work with peace of mind.

[h2]The Saving Grace: Vanquishing the Character Reset Curse[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3b51dedf469a4ff79df0f2f8ebc7ce5a00a4de08.jpg[/img]
Hear ye, hear ye! A great bane hath been driven from our lands—the dreaded curse that would reset thy character upon exit hath met its end. To achieve this victory, a player-save mechanism hath been strengthened, ensuring thy hard-won progress remains steadfast.

While we offer this fix with hearts full of hope, we beseech thee to report any lingering traces of the reset blight. Should its foul vestiges remain, know that our battle against it shall endure until its eradication is absolute.

[h2]Looking Ahead: What Awaits Beyond the Horizon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/bd442b19ba84372a53aa20aa7292885e10e42058.jpg[/img]
These changes mark but one chapter in the saga of Crestfallen. The winds of innovation stir evermore, and our guilds labor unceasingly to bring forth new wonders and resolve lingering woes. Thy feedback, dear adventurers, remains the cornerstone of our endeavors. Share thy tales, thy triumphs, and thy trials, and together we shall shape a world worthy of legends.

Prepare thy arms and gird thy spirit, for the realm of Crestfallen calls anew. Whether thou art drawn to the Demonic Ruins, the Orcen Encampment of RockThralm, or the serene glades of the re-sculpted forests, thy destiny awaits.

[h2]Closing Words of Gratitude and Resolve[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/57d9492fbafea74c8bb89fde349fb741dff9700a.jpg[/img]
We extend our deepest thanks to the valiant players who inhabit and enrich Crestfallen. Thy resilience, camaraderie, and passion inspire us to ever greater heights. As thy journey unfolds, may thy adventures be ever rewarding and thy spirit unyielding.

Until next we meet, may the stars guide thy path, and may thy endeavors bring glory to thy name.

Raise thy banners high and let the tales of thy deeds echo through Tyraellia!

King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/e0ec61a52734e5d3361d43def49cd16829abc10c.png[/img]

notes.title: Tyraellia is Born - Claim the Riches, Ride to Glory, or Die in Battle!
notes.content:
Crestfallen has exploded in size with the introduction of Tyraellia, a map so huge it will take many campaigns to conquer all the land. 

[b]Horses for roaming the land have also been successfully integrated!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/220d554f4110c1820f6ccf0d1628057257e4b6b4.png[/img]

We’re talking about sprawling landscapes filled with breathtaking waterfalls, dense forests, and towering mountain ranges. Explore the ruins of ancient castles, uncover hidden ruins, and stumble upon unexpected surprises like abandoned treasure troves. There’s enough room for grand adventures, epic battles, and quiet moments of contemplative strategery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/1eeaa70ea307fb78c34c11fc98278b0a7e7de344.jpg[/img]

[b]Bigger Build Areas for Your Medieval Masterpiece[/b]
 
Calling all Castle Builders! The expanded map includes massive new areas designed specifically for True Kings. Whether you're crafting a humble hideout or an elaborate fortress, you'll have the space to make your medieval dreams come true. Plus, these larger zones make it easier to avoid raids—or to set up traps for would-be attackers. See the amazing wonders that have been created recently. SPECTACULAR!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/59098f7baa91a5eac5fe4a975c4ba897b46ca436.jpg[/img]

[b]We are going to try a 1 month wipe cycle for longer play time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/c702b17ca2ba33bcea160ad8811b2fb72c5697b0.jpg[/img]

[b]Will You FInd a Way to The Castle in the Sky?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3ca2cbfd7c822885b2a611dacae3cc78ca0b2ef2.jpg[/img]
 
Tyraellia isn’t just bigger—it’s richer. Discover a sprawling orc encampment filled with loot (if you’re brave enough to claim it), an enchanting elven village with a magical elder tree at its heart, and crumbling castles waiting to be conquered. These areas aren’t just for show; each one offers unique challenges, resources, and rewards to those daring enough to explore them. And don’t forget about the waterfalls—they’re not just pretty; some hide secrets worth finding.

The Vikings have sailed form afar to terrorize the region!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/9459904cc13faf7f37b6e735c3960a35e10ca68c.jpg[/img]

The wilderness is more alive than ever with an expanded roster of animals and enemies. From majestic deer roaming the forests to fearsome wolves ready to pounce, Tyraellia feels truly untamed. Keep an eye out for mythical creatures around the elder tree and beware the orcs—they’re smarter, stronger, and more cunning than ever before.  

[b]Smoother Gameplay, Thanks to Hundreds of Small Changes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/c8581d18fd306c138a7a6ee9c70ff13e5bcc2920.jpg[/img]
 
We didn’t just give you a bigger map—we’ve fine-tuned **everything** to make your experience smoother. From faster crafting times to better inventory management, you’ll notice countless small tweaks that make a big difference. Resource gathering is more intuitive, combat feels more responsive, and navigating the menus is no longer a struggle. It’s like Crestfallen had a glow-up.

[i]Character Reset Bug is FIXED!
[/i]

[b]More Ways to Gather Resources[/b]

You’ve got more options than ever to stay alive and thrive. Harvest rare herbs from the elven village, mine new ore veins near the mountains, or raid enemy camps for supplies. We’ve added more resource nodes across the map, making it easier to stock up on essentials. Just remember, nothing comes free—be ready to fight for what you find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/69a327eb45e40f800cf41ee18bcfe004888f7e1f.png[/img]

[b]Places to Hide and Ambush[/b]

With raiders lurking around every corner, survival means thinking smarter. The new map is full of strategic hiding spots, from dense thickets to abandoned buildings. Set up an ambush, evade a pursuer, or simply take a breather in one of the many secluded areas scattered across Tyraellia. And if you’re feeling bold, use the terrain to turn the tables on your enemies.

[b]Improvements You Can Feel[/b]

This update isn’t just about what’s new—it’s about making everything better. Hundreds of quality-of-life changes mean smoother mechanics, fewer bugs, and more ways to immerse yourself in the medieval chaos. Whether it’s the addition of auto-run (finally!) or subtle changes like better enemy AI, the game just *feels* better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/52d920f3a18f9941fd64046cc89da5704772600a.png[/img]

[b]Raiding, Fighting, and Role-Playing—All Enhanced[/b]

With new factions like the Vikings and smarter enemy AI, combat is more intense than ever. Whether you’re charging into battle on horseback or sneaking into a castle to loot supplies, every encounter feels dynamic and rewarding. Plus, the addition of unique locations like the orc camp and elven village adds depth to your role-playing adventures.

[b]Your Next Adventure Awaits[/b]

Crestfallen’s biggest update yet is here, and it’s time for you to dive in. With a massive new world, horseback combat, and more ways to play, there’s never been a better time to jump into the fray. Will you build an empire, conquer the Vikings, or become a legend in Tyraellia? The choice is yours—grab your sword and make history!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/dfe1bfa9d4f8bbfbe04e50514dd3cce94a3dfc05.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone for all the support and help play test and share ideas to help make this a more immersive, fun game.

Warmest wishes,
King Burkheart the Keeper of Justice

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/96eeeeeb2a8b9d0af377877d4552db660ddae315.png[/img]

The IronGuard Summit stands resolute, but its days are numbered. This shall be the final server wipe for this storied map before we unveil the sprawling, untamed lands of Tyraellia—a realm vast enough to challenge even the most seasoned explorers. As a lone artisan forging this grand experience, I humbly thank thee for thy patience. Progress may be slow, yet I labor tirelessly to ensure every blade of grass, every shadow of the mountains, and every clash of steel is as vivid as the tales of old. Bring forth thy companions and delve deep into our intricate crafting system—build, survive, and thrive together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/8f7aff188cc043dc9f66eb1317ba5f2b7d0ee7ff.png[/img]

Should thee seek glory, cast thine eyes upon the Red Shield Castle. Storm its bloodstained gates, cut down the elite guards that defend the tyrant king, and lay claim to his golden crown. But beware! notes.title: The Gates of Hell Hath Opened!! Fight back the Demons of Hell.
notes.content:
Hail, Adventurers of Crestfallen!

[b]The Gates of Hell Have Opened: New Challenges and Legendary Gear Await[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/0661ef0f32d4737e1c8b7bbecd4622fc64b6adbe.png[/img]

Brave warriors and cunning mages, hear this dire proclamation: The very fabric of our world has been torn asunder, and the Gates of Hell have been flung wide open! From the depths of the inferno, unspeakable horrors have emerged, bringing with them new challenges that will test the mettle of even the most seasoned adventurers.
[b]
Infernal Foes and Fearsome Bosses[/b]

The denizens of Hell are not mere minions, but terrifying foes that will push you to your limits. Prepare to face off against monstrous new bosses, each more fearsome than the last. These abominations of darkness have emerged from the abyss with a singular purpose—to destroy all who dare stand in their way. Only those with unwavering courage and skill will survive the onslaught.

Among these fiends, legends speak of a behemoth whose roar shakes the very earth, and a dark sorcerer whose command over the arcane is unparalleled. Defeating these harbingers of doom will not be easy, but the rewards... oh, the rewards shall be great!

[b]Legendary Gear Forged in the Fires of Hell[/b]

For those who dare to face these infernal foes, new legendary gear awaits, forged in the very fires of Hell itself. This gear is unlike any seen before in Crestfallen—imbued with otherworldly power, it will give you the strength to overcome the mightiest of enemies. From hell-forged blades that burn with unholy fire to armor that can withstand the most devastating blows, this new gear will be essential for those who seek to survive the challenges that lie ahead.

These powerful artifacts are not easily obtained. Only those who conquer the most formidable bosses will have the chance to claim these relics of immense power. But beware—possessing such power may come with a price.

[b]A Call to Arms
[/b]
The Gates of Hell are not to be taken lightly. The dangers are many, and the path is fraught with peril. But for those who rise to the challenge, the glory will be unmatched. Gather your allies, sharpen your blades, and prepare your spells—the time has come to march into the depths of Hell itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/49e3cce745eb9f34d3c0bd0d255cbf5579015178.jpg[/img]

The Keepers watch over you, and the fate of Crestfallen hangs in the balance. Will you be the one to seal the Gates of Hell and bring peace to the land once more? Or will you fall, consumed by the darkness?

As the sun sets over the battle-scarred fields and the echoes of skirmishes fade into the night, we bring you tidings of great import. The lands of Crestfallen have undergone a profound transformation, one that shall reshape the very fabric of your journey through these perilous realms. The Council of the Keepers has convened, and through their wisdom, we present the latest parchments detailing the grand updates to our world.

[b]A New Dawn for Archers and Sorcerers Alike[/b]

No longer shall the swift hand of the archer be hindered by the potions they quaff. The bow, crossbow, and even the mystical tomes of crystal and book have been freed from the shackles of cooldowns. Lo! Your arrows and bolts shall fly true, unimpeded by the brews that enhance your prowess. Embrace this newfound freedom, for the battlefield awaits your skill with bated breath.

[b]The Winds of Change: Agility and Intelligence Rebalanced[/b]

The gods have decreed that Agility, once a boon to your armor, shall now only sharpen your tools for mining and woodcutting. Armor shall no longer bow to the whims of speed. Meanwhile, Intelligence, that sharp blade of the mind, has been tempered. No longer shall it bolster your strikes against tree and stone, and the flow of mana it commands has been gently curtailed. Take heed, mages, for the path to power now requires greater cunning.
[b]
Endurance Tempered by the Flames of Battle[/b]

Stamina, the wellspring of your vitality, has faced the forge. The whispers of ancient healers have grown faint, and the health regeneration you once knew has been tempered to ensure that only the strong thrive in these unforgiving lands.
[b]
Strengthened Shoulders, Heavier Loads[/b]

Adventurers, rejoice! The burden you bear has been lightened. No longer shall you groan under the weight of your spoils, for the base carry weight has been increased from 800 to 1200. Gather your treasures, for the world is ripe with opportunity, and your newfound strength shall serve you well.

[b]A Commanding Presence: The Admin Panel Emerges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/34ea6a15108b6dfc58b62c18732b282fd4ed092e.jpg[/img]

To the overseers of these lands, we bestow the Admin Panel—a powerful tool of governance, replete with functionalities to shape the very world around you. With this new power, may you guide your realms with wisdom and justice, ensuring that all who tread upon Crestfallen’s soil do so with honor.
[b]
Bows and Crossbows: Precision Perfected[/b]

The bow and crossbow, those stalwart companions of the ranger, have been honed to perfection. Now, they work like a dream, their strings taut with anticipation, their bolts and arrows swift as the wind. Take them in hand, and let your enemies tremble at the sight of your prowess.
[b]
Burkheart’s Decree: Shields and Fair Combat[/b]

Burkheart, the Keeper of Justice, has spoken: the durability of shields has been reduced by a staggering 90%. No longer shall these barriers grant undue advantage. The balance of combat has been restored, ensuring that every clash of steel is a true test of skill.
[b]
The Wisdom of Lord Andrew: A Call for Balance[/b]

In his tireless quest for fairness, Lord Andrew the Just has seen to it that all weapons have been rebalanced. The time-to-kill (TTK) across the board has been adjusted, promising dynamic and thrilling battles. Agility now grants greater might in mining and woodcutting, yet archers shall find their attack speed reduced, demanding greater precision. Furthermore, the arcane arts have grown more elusive, with higher levels of magic now requiring greater experience to wield.
[b]
The Light of the Torches and the Call to Adventure[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/bb54a1984011e0f8cb36e3e99e597be8b2e9c4a2.png[/img]

Burkheart's final decree has brought forth a brighter future—literally. The radius of torchlight has been increased, piercing the darkness and guiding your steps through the treacherous night. And fear not, for quest items have been added to the barkeep’s wares as a temporary salve to the server issues.
[b]
The Road Ahead[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/89ea9ee3a8f2ccfe5dd91f5659c17a35d0e416e4.jpg[/img]

As the fires of change burn bright, we invite you, brave souls, to venture forth and explore the new horizons of Crestfallen. These updates are but the beginning of a grand saga, one that you shall write with your own deeds and valor. Step into the world anew, and let the chronicles of your journey be sung by bards for generations to come.

The Keepers watch over you, and the path to glory awaits. Will you rise to the challenge?

[b]For The Crown![/b]


But that is not all, noble adventurers...

The Keepers have been hard at work, their eyes keen and their hands swift, to rid our lands of the lurking bugs that sought to undermine your journey. Countless issues have been addressed, from minor nuisances to more pernicious glitches, all in the name of smoother, more immersive gameplay. The road ahead is now clearer, the experience richer, and the challenges more rewarding. Your journey through Crestfallen shall be unmarred by the disruptions of old, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the trials and triumphs that await.

Step forth, and may your path be ever smoother as you carve your legend in Crestfallen!

-King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
"JUSTICE WILL BE SERVED!!"

notes.title: Edicts of Forge and Flame - Dispatches of Swift Repair, Hotfix Highlights
notes.content:
Greetings, brave souls of Crestfallen,

What an exhilarating first day it has been! We extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you who embarked on this journey with us. Your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable as we navigate the uncharted realms of our new world.

In the wake of our launch, we've been hard at work addressing your initial experiences and concerns. Here are some of the key fixes and adjustments we've implemented:

[b]Increased Server Capacity[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/6fe3e300ff761e2642bcf49630dbe7c3270fe16d.jpg[/img]

Our servers can now comfortably accommodate up to 50 players at a time, ensuring smoother gameplay and reduced wait times.

[b]Improved Player Re-connection [/b]

Players should no longer encounter issues with getting stuck on loading screens when reconnecting to the game.

[b]Bulwark of Castle Wall[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/3c312d0fbb14539bc501bc1cb110e8027ad37112.png[/img]

Slow down siege and raider attacks drastically. Castle Wall, Castle Gate, and Castle Turret Hit Points have been buffed from 35,000 hp to 350,000 hp. They now are more secure than stone wall for raid defense.

[b]Weapon Balancing[/b]

The damage of the Steel T3 Halberd has been adjusted from 205 to 150, with durability reduced from 500 to 50. These changes aim to balance gameplay and reduce raiding efficiency.

[b]Camera Stability[/b]

We've disabled camera shake for players who are not actively casting Meteor spells, enhancing overall visual comfort during gameplay.

[b]Spell Adjustments [/b]

Meteor and fire spells have been overhauled to ensure they no longer inadvertently damage internal structures and are more finely tuned for balance.

[b]Teleportation Mechanics[/b]

Teleportation is now too expensive to cast, but for those cunning enough to uncover a secret path, the possibility remains open.

[b]Economic Balance[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44812583/83276cb711d2d02eaed06ce8438d968cec0c6f66.png[/img]

Spear racks in town and certain higher-tier loot have been strategically removed to offer new adventurers a more balanced starting experience.

[b]Better Burn Rate[/b]

Wall torches and  candelabras are now burning fuel at a much slower rate so you wont have to refill often at all!

Your feedback continues to guide us as we strive to refine and perfect Crestfallen. Together, we are forging a world where every decision and adjustment aims to enhance your gameplay experience.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue this epic journey together. Remember, your adventures shape the future of Crestfallen!

May your swords stay sharp and your spirits high.


My sword is at thy service,

King Burkheart The Keeper of Justice
